title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Model Council in Researcher runs Anthropic and OpenAI models side by side
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents parallel model reports, but not the briefing's assertion that every run sends the retrieved work content to both models. The control paths, blocking endpoint and licensing are supported; narrow the unsupported data-flow and report-only assurances and flag the blocking API's preview status.

claims.claim: Council runs models from different providers in parallel for comparison of consensus and conflict.
claims.quote: Council in Researcher runs multiple leading AI models from different providers in parallel in one place, so you can quickly compare outputs and see consensus vs. conflict)
